scores.notes: The card courtier at right shows numeral-like corner indices (6/9 shapes) beside the diamond pips. Alice at left, Queen at right and the Cheshire Cat's head between them on the croquet lawn.
The titulus plaque atop the cross carries a faint row of dark glyph-like marks. Four helmeted soldiers crouch casting dice over garments below the distant cross.
A painted signature-like scrawl sits in the grass at the bottom-right corner. Alice in front with a guarded look, the Queen close behind and the grinning Cat's head floating at centre.
The bottle label Alice holds up carries several lines of scribbled script-like marks. Lamp-lit hall, glass table with key and a small door behind.
The Rabbit's open scroll shows faint lines of text and many papers on the floor carry scribbled writing lines. Rabbit at a stand reading, King and Queen at right, Alice and jury at left.
The glowing panel behind the hand is blank and the glazed-brick lions, borders and corners show no marks. Daniel at left with raised hands facing the seated Belshazzar at right.
Pen squiggles in the hedge at upper right form letter-like pseudo-script (d, e, S shapes). Alice holds the flamingo at left, card soldiers arch across the lawn and the crimson Queen shouts at right.
The large foreground stone marker bears clearly carved multi-line letter inscriptions, and the next stone has faint marks too. Row of markers along the village road with villagers and a soldier.
Papers scattered on the floor (lower left and centre right) show lines of writing. The Hatter bites his teacup holding bread while the Queen peers through spectacles beside the King.
Scrolls at his belt and on the table are closed and plain, and walls and market show no signs. Paul gazes into a bronze mirror with believers behind under the colonnade.
The bottle label is blank and no marks appear on walls, floor or corners. Alice raises the bottle in the lamp-lit hall with the glass table, key and small padlocked door.
Columns, glazed-brick lions, throne carving and the glowing hand's wall area show no glyphs. Daniel faces the seated king with the bright hand glowing on the wall between them.

Papers on the floor at right carry text lines and the playing cards near the dais show corner index marks. Alice faces the dais, the King holds his note-book and the Queen leans toward him, jury box behind.

Card courtiers at left show numeral corner indices (8, 6, 9) and floor papers carry scribbled text lines. Alice stands before the dais with the King holding his note-book and the Queen leaning in, jury at right.
The glowing hand writes a row of glyph-like characters on the blue brick wall near the candles. Daniel with raised hand faces the seated king at right.
A cursive signature-like scrawl appears in the grass at lower left and the arched cards show corner indices. Alice holds the flamingo at left while the crimson Queen stamps and shouts at right.
The wall glow is blank and lion friezes and corners show no marks. Daniel with raised hands faces the seated king with the glowing wall between them.
Gate, walls, stalls, chests and jars carry no writing. Golden light pours through the open city gate into the square as townsfolk raise their hands toward it.

Faint carved glyph-like marks appear on the front stone's panel and rows of faint text-like marks on the far-left marker. A line of stone markers recedes along the village road with villagers and a soldier.
The titulus plaque on the cross looks blank with only mottled texture, and no other marks are visible. Four soldiers crouch casting lots with garments around and the crucified figure above.

Faint text-like strokes and a ruled header line are visible on the papers on the floor at bottom centre; the Rabbit's scroll and jury slates are blank. Rabbit reads at the stand with King and Queen behind, Alice at left and jury at right.
Scrolls on the ledge and at the belt are closed and plain; walls and market show no writing. Paul gazes into a bronze mirror with believers around him in the arcaded courtyard.
Gate, shrine panels, chests and houses show no inscriptions. Radiant light floods through the city gate into the street as people raise hands toward it.
